notes: Timed to opener-v3.mp4 and confirmed against /workspace/motd-shots/17x-work/review/ frames. At least 0.3 s between lines. Silent: 0-15.6, 44.0-58.6 (drop and title), 73.3-77.9 (twitch). PA ding about 0.3 s before each PA line. No narrator. All lines 70 characters or fewer. STORY.md later distinguishes a dispatcher from Ashby; this opener's Radio lines are cast as Ashby per the voice brief.

cast.speaker: Radio
cast.notes: STORY.md calls the first Vector Control call a dispatcher; opener brief casts these lines as Ashby

cues.speaker: PA
cues.text: Security, please confirm the east doors.
cues.notes: Ding ~15.3. Calm, bored. Ceiling speaker, food-court reverb.

cues.speaker: Mall Cop
cues.notes: Into shoulder radio. Clipped, by the book. Squelch.

cues.speaker: PA
cues.text: Driver for Kern Valley, please pull to Dock B.
cues.notes: Ding ~26.5, muffled through a dock door, low-pass, under the diesel.

cues.speaker: Biker
cues.notes: To himself, eyes on pager. Low, flat. Clear by the 32.0 cut.

cues.speaker: PA
cues.text: Paging Champ. Your party is at the fountain.
cues.notes: Ding ~32.0. Same rhythm; don't lean on 'Champ'.

cues.speaker: Skater
cues.notes: Joke reflex, comes out too quiet.

cues.speaker: PA
cues.text: Photo order 1854, please come to Guest Services.

cues.speaker: Mall Goth
cues.text: Nobody picks up a photo order at midnight.
cues.notes: Dry, unhurried. Close mic, not muffled: respirator is not on in this shot.

cues.speaker: Skater
cues.notes: After he stands (confirmed at t59). Hoarse, small, not tearful.

cues.speaker: Action News 17
cues.text: A refinery leak. Stay indoors. Keep windows shut.

cues.speaker: Mall Cop
cues.text: Refinery's nine miles off. They knew in three minutes?
cues.notes: Quiet, doing the math. Pause after 'off.'

cues.speaker: Radio
cues.text: Vector Control base. How many survivors, Officer?
cues.notes: Handset filter. Warm, even. Voice-over on the convoy.

cues.speaker: Radio
cues.notes: Gentle, certain. Clear before the 73.5 twitch.

cues.speaker: Skater
cues.text: Four thousand dropped. Why are we four still standing?
cues.notes: After the twitch beat. Genuinely asking.

cues.speaker: PA
cues.text: Shoppers, please remain where you are. Help is on the way.
cues.notes: Ding ~82.3. Same bored 11:58 voice. Done by 85.6; hard cut at 86.0.
